final: SELECT trader.tradekind, COUNT(advancedbehavior.abhvreg) as record_count, COUNT(advancedbehavior.abhvreg) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(advancedbehavior.abhvreg)) OVER () as share FROM advancedbehavior JOIN transactionrecord ON advancedbehavior.translink = transactionrecord.transreg JOIN trader ON transactionrecord.trdref = trader.tradereg GROUP BY trader.tradekind ORDER BY record_count DESC
